evidence_class: Static frozen-source review only. QA ran no inventory, test, build, solver, physical assembly, or numerical calculation.

findings.title: W01 does not assert the held-base-copy attempted delta alongside its completed delta.
findings.evidence: The scatter helper increments both bvls05_held_base_copies_attempted and bvls05_held_base_copies_completed for each held coordinate. W01 asserts completed=2 and, after absorb, completed=4, but never checks attempted=2 or attempted=4. Plan06 requires exact attempted/completed dedicated deltas; a one-sided counter regression can therefore pass this control.
findings.required_fix: Assert held-base-copy attempted=2 before absorb and =4 after absorb, together with the existing completion assertions.

verified_fixes.selector_scope: Exactly the eight plan06 pre-body selectors are present; the unplanned retained_face_trace_custody_red selector is absent.
verified_fixes.R01: The capture now derives the earliest available face ids from the first operation, or otherwise an explicitly first-factorization/no-pivot refusal, without requiring a terminal result. It retains actual G4 raw/weighted provenance and the 19 retained ids.
verified_fixes.R03: The control exercises the actual KKT transition with a 21-coordinate state, fixed/lower-active/upper-active partitions, and checks release behavior plus held-coordinate KKT observations.
verified_fixes.R05_R06: Both synthetic fixtures now take a real RefinementObservationTrace from solve_subproblem and assert the exact 19 retained ids/order, p0/p1/p2 values including held +0 bits, masks, final result, and candidate base-coordinate reconstruction. No historical capture substitutes for those executions.
verified_fixes.R07: The default-empty control has independent zero and positive-lambda result assertions, zero dedicated route deltas, and deterministic Debug JSON emission for the declared external pre/post-body baseline comparison; it is not represented as a self-oracle.
verified_fixes.confinement: The observation path is test-only and static review found no production numerical-method body change beyond opt-in trace copies.

missing_execution_evidence.inventory04: Still compiling at review time; no supplied compile/list receipt or selector execution result was inspected.
missing_execution_evidence.expected_red: No expected-red selector execution was performed by QA or supplied as evidence.

disposition: BLOCKED pending the single W01 attempted-counter assertion and a newly manifested successful inventory. This review does not authorize the expected-red gate or a numerical-body release.
